title: The Paid Campus Program and Desk Packets
lessons: The player sees a student promoting CELSIUS and learns that CELSIUS University is a paid campus marketing program.
The player already drinks CELSIUS cans but keeps On-The-Go powder packets in a desk drawer.

text: Someone on your feed is holding a can between classes. Same can as always. Their bio says CELSIUS University, and it turns out that's a job.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Is that student actually working for you?

entry-first-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Probably, yeah! Why do quiet word of mouth when I can do a whole program?

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: I thought it was just somebody posting a can between classes.

entry-first-4.speaker: CELSIUS
text: It's both. CELSIUS University pays student ambassadors to post, throw campus events, and hang out with other reps. They get paid, they get a line for their resume, I get a can in every dorm photo.

choice-first.speaker: CELSIUS
text: You're staring at the phone. Come on, out with it.

choices.text: That's real work experience and smart campus marketing.
So the casual post is also a paid brand job.
I'd rather get a recommendation from someone who isn't paid to spread it.

first-1.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Right? They get experience, I get noise. Everybody's happy. Mostly me, but everybody.

first-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Yep. Paid to post. I'm not going to act embarrassed about it now, I'd have to act embarrassed about a lot.

first-2-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Okay. I just wanted that said out loud.

first-3.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Fair. Getting paid changes how a recommendation feels, even one shouted across a quad. I'd still rather pay them than pretend I didn't.
Desk drawer, second one down. Behind the stapler there's a row of CELSIUS On-The-Go powder packets you don't remember buying that many of.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: You live in my desk now?

entry-return-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: I live in your desk now! Powder packets. I couldn't stand the thought of a whole afternoon where you couldn't reach me.

entry-return-4.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Two hundred milligrams. The drawer version is me admitting you don't always have a cold can, and refusing to sit that one out.

choice-return.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Don't count them. Just tell me if you're mad.

choices.text: That's useful when I can't get a cold can.
Powder is easier to overdo because it's always right there.
I don't want caffeine living in my desk drawer.

return-1.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Right! Nothing new in it, just a way to have me when the fridge is three floors down.

return-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Yeah. That's fair. Portable means easy to reach for, and I'm not exactly built for restraint. Neither is the drawer.

return-3.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Then the drawer gets one less thing in it. You know your afternoons better than my marketing does. I hate that, but it's true.
